parameters.description:
`msg-to-spugpush` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SpugPush destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own SpugPush destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional SpugPush destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign in at push.spug.dev and generate your token; SpugPush shows you a full webhook URL such as https://push.spug.dev/send/abc123def456ghi789jkl012mno345pq. Copy the token segment at the end of that URL and set it as SPUGPUSH_TOKEN.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SpugPush destinations, direct
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own SpugPush destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SpugPush token
